title: Spaces of metrics with positive spectral scalar curvature
summary: Let $n\geq2$ and let $M^n$ be a closed connected smooth manifold. Let $R^γ(M)$ be the space of smooth Riemannian metrics $g$ on $M$ for which the generalized conformal Laplace operator $-γΔ_g+\mathrm{R}_g$ is strictly positive. We prove that if $n=2$ and $γ>0$, or if $n\ge3$ and $0 4(n-1)/(n-2)$, the space $R^γ(M)$ is contractible, and hence nonempty. This solves a homotopy-theoretic strengthening of a conjecture of Gromov (Conjecture 3, Section 6.1.2, "Four Lectures on Scalar Curvature") in the maximal possible coefficient range.
